verdict.rationale: Graphite is a SaaS developer platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found all candidate OpenAPI and Swagger paths returning 404. The CLI, MCP server and markdown docs are adjacent features and do not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
